description: A Python test suite passes locally but fails in CI with a timestamp assertion error. Investigate the CI configuration (.github/workflows/ci.yml) and local environment to identify the environmental difference causing the discrepancy. Create a diagnostic report at /home/ga/workspace/timestamp_service/CI_MISMATCH_DIAGNOSIS.md that explains: (1) what environmental difference exists between CI and local, (2) how it causes the test to behave differently, and (3) a recommended fix or workaround.
